findings.title: ChatGPT as a Time Capsule: The Limits of Price Discovery
findings.reason: Frozen ChatGPT snapshots 2021-2025 used as a point-in-time-safe historical text-information proxy; LLM outlook score predicts 1-month cross-sectional returns (t=6.02); mechanism argued to be aggregation cost, not investor inattention. Distinct from H174's single-document FinBERT scoring -- proposes a multi-document synthesis score as a complementary, not competing, signal. Applied directly to wiki (low risk, wiki_update).

findings.title: From Hypotheses to Factors: Constrained LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency Markets
findings.reason: Governance-layer paper, not a new discovery algorithm: point-in-time factor DSL makes look-ahead bias structurally inexpressible, plus an append-only experiment log. Crypto ridge portfolio trained 2020-2022, OOS 2024-2026 44.55% annualized, Sharpe 1.55 net 5bp. Concrete transferable idea flagged in the wiki page: a PITSeries.shift(1)-enforcing wrapper class that would have structurally caught the H256 unlagged-signal incident. Applied directly to wiki (low risk, wiki_update).

findings.title: Tail Risk Management with Puts and Trend Following: A CVaR Framework for Crashes and Drawdowns
findings.reason: HJB CVaR framework blending OTM puts (instant protection on a jump) with trend-following overlays (lags the first shock, compounds defensive through a persistent drawdown). Filed as a Phase-2 tail-hedge overlay design candidate distinct from H273 (vol-targeting) and H320 (crash filter). Applied directly to wiki (low risk, wiki_update).
